title: lore 0.9.1: lore new story scaffolds into docs/stories/ with type Arc until 1.0.0 (ODOC-262, OPAG-376)
description: Implements opum-doc ODOC-262 (docs/adr/scope-lore-new-storys-output-path-to-docs-stories-until-1.0.0.md, opum-doc dev 3384f7f, opum-ai/opum-doc#412), ruling OPAG-376. 0.9.0 scaffolds both lore new story and lore new arc into docs/arcs/, which breaks lore's own README quickstart (README.md:190-226) and opum-cli-e2e's consumer-condorcet fixture (TASK-103). Until 1.0.0 the output DIRECTORY follows the matched input spelling (Story, any case -> docs/stories/), and the written type stays canonical (type: Arc). Documents 0.9.0 already wrote under docs/arcs/ are not migrated.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore new story "X" (any case of the Story spelling) writes docs/stories/x.md with type: Arc; lore new arc "X" still writes docs/arcs/x.md
test/new.test.ts:72 flips deliberately to docs/stories/, with a test for lore new arc keeping docs/arcs/
The 0.9.1 CHANGELOG corrects the 0.9.0 line saying both spellings scaffold into docs/arcs/, and the 1.0.0 deprecation notice names the docs/stories/ output path

AMENDED 2026-09-23 from "README.md:190-226 quickstart runs UNEDITED against a built 0.9.1 binary", which is an impossible premise: run verbatim, steps 3 (lore new spec --story) and 5 (lore link to Backlog tasks) fail on 0.9.0 AND on this fix, for reasons unrelated to the path (LCLI-571). Measured criterion: every quickstart command that addresses stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders resolves against the built binary, where 0.9.0 exits 3 not-in-bundle
Version bumped to 0.9.1 and a release staged; publication taken to the user, not performed on relay

implementationNotes: Quickstart proof, 2026-09-23. README.md:187-226 was extracted by awk (not retyped) and run in fresh git repos via a PATH shim. FIX (dist/lore built from this branch): lore new story -> docs/stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders.md; context, tasks, query --type story and check all exit 0 on stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders. CONTROL (installed @opum-ai/lore 0.9.0): new story -> docs/arcs/; link, context and tasks exit 3 'concept "stories/bulk-archive-completed-orders" is not in the bundle'. Both binaries also fail 'new spec --story' (exit 2, the option never existed) and link fails on the fix for want of a Quest workspace (exit 6) -> LCLI-571. Mutation: dropping the spelling argument in new.ts turns exactly the 2 new tests red (77 pass / 2 fail), as predicted. Full suite 3373 pass / 0 fail, typecheck clean, lint clean (3 pre-existing warnings), bun run lore check 0 errors.

Fix landed on dev as 4def41a0 via opum-ai/lore-cli#233. All 14 checks were green on PR head eee7f41a, including the docker e2e harness, which runs lore new Story against the real binary. Bump to 0.9.1 prepared on chore/LCLI-570-bump-0.9.1: registry read 2026-09-23T20:19Z showed latest=0.9.0 and 0.9.1 E404 on all seven names. Ladybug: only canonicalExportSha256 moved; the negative control (root version back to 0.9.0) passed 3/0 against the old baselines.
finalSummary: Shipped in lore 0.9.1, implementing opum-doc ODOC-262 (OPAG-376). lore new story, in any case, scaffolds into docs/stories/<slug>.md with type: Arc; lore new arc keeps docs/arcs/.
